name: Dwaji_Prologue
source:
You follow Lyra, a technician working deep within an offshore energy facility, as a routine task slowly unravels into something far less comprehensible.

[From [url=https://nomituinen.itch.io/dwajiprologue]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
萊拉是一名在海上能源設施深處工作的技術員。你將跟隨她，看著一項例行任務一點點失控，演變成遠超理解範圍的事。
